value.rationale: The natural three-particle cancellation at N=3 is explicitly singled out by the motivating paper and occurs at the first population exhibiting ancestral circulation. Resolving its first surviving quintic term and strict sign along the full symmetric killing line supplies a non-implied, structurally informative comparison: for sufficiently small positive contrast the circulation direction for N=3 is opposite that for any fixed N>=4. The result is not an arbitrary numerical slice; it answers the exceptional order question created by an established population-dependent coefficient vanishing.
